title: Invertibility of the recorded degree-zero completed Koszul unit
statement: Let T be a scheme, A a commutative ring, d an adic coefficient datum on A, r a natural number, a : Fin r -> A and n a natural number. The actual map completedAdicKoszulUnitZero T d r a n from the unit module sheaf of the completed coefficient ring to degree zero of the recorded completed Koszul complex [lem-weil-pbc-completed-adic-koszul-unit-chain-map] is an isomorphism. No regularity, nonzero-ring or positive-rank hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 099M finite exterior Koszul complexes, exterior degree zero; Tag 03EK scalar extension of module sheaves. Expansion of the unit-invertibility step in lem-weil-pbc-completed-koszul-tensor-cone-comparison.

proof.text: Constant sheafification of the rank-one coefficient module identifies its generator one with the module unit. Construct the inverse by the sheafification Hom equivalence and the global section one of the ring sheaf. The unit-module/section equivalence proves one composite is the identity; the same sheafification Hom equivalence and the rank-one linear-map extensionality prove the other. Compose this isomorphism with exteriorPower.zeroEquiv inverse to get invertibility of koszulSheafUnitZero.

Apply the actual normalized scalar extension functor to this isomorphism. Precompose with the inverse of the scalar-extension unit comparison, transported by the normalized object equality for the extension functor. The tensor formula for its inverse inserts one tensor one.

The normalized morphism formula for scalar extension and naturality of the sheafification unit show that this composite sends one to the sheafified tensor of one with the Koszul unit. Uniqueness in completedAdicKoszulUnitZero_exists identifies the composite with the recorded completed unit. It is a composite of isomorphisms.
